title: Remote test-ref runs from an independent clone are refused at registration (run directory outside the project's run directories)
outcome: A remote runner following the test-ref procedure can launch the standard full gate on the exact test ref without a registration refusal, and the procedure text says which placement the host accepts.
acceptance: The test-ref runner procedure (CLAUDE.md test-ref bullet and docs/test.md) states the supported placement: a fresh detached worktree of the project's registered repository on the runner host, or the host accepts an independent clone's run directory; the two no longer disagree.
A remote full gate launched exactly as the documented procedure says registers successfully on a host with the current build.
